bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Quick fixes & improvements

## Fixes

- Fixed Google account sync from Settings
- Added easier ways to send feedback, rate, and share CogniFocus
- Improved timing so prompts don't overlap during sessions

## Why this matters

What's New (v4.3.1) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Quick fixes & improvements gets a little more room to breathe.
- Fixed Google account sync from Settings gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added easier ways to send feedback, rate, and share CogniFocus gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved timing so prompts don't overlap during sessions gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
